messages.subject: question about diffAnn and diffCpGann
parts:
Hello,

when I create the obj

diffAnn<-annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p,gene.obj)
and
diffCpGann<-annotate.WithFeature.Flank(myDiff25p,cpg.obj$CpGi,cpg.obj$shores,feature.name="CpGi",flank.name="shores")

I'd like to actually know which CpGs falls in which category and what's the feature.name or flank.name associated with. Something like a data.frame I can output with write.table.

Thanks!

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] question about diffAnn and diffCpGann
parts:
There is no function which can do that directly in methylKit, but it is very simple task using GenomicRanges package. All methylKit objects are coercible to GRanges objects (see the vignette). Following  the coercion, you can use findOverlaps() from GenomicRanges which will return a matrix showing which DMCs/DMRs overlap with which CpG islands.

Best,
Altuna
